items.raw_excerpt: When visiting Águeda, I was mainly looking forward to seeing its famous umbrella-covered streets. However, before we even reached the town centre, we started noticing beautiful flower decorations covering the fronts of several buildings.
items.summary_en: The town of Agueda in Portugal is famous for its streets covered with colourful umbrellas. Before you even reach the centre, you notice several buildings dressed in bright flower decorations. Some people call it the most colourful town on earth.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 아구다 마을은 알록달록한 우산으로 뒤덮인 거리로 유명합니다. 마을 중앙에 닿기도 전에 여러 건물의 앞을 화려한 꽃 장식이 꾸민 것을 보게 됩니다. 세계에서 가장 색채로운 마을이라는 말을 듣기도 합니다.
items.title_en: Is Agueda the most colourful town in the world?
items.title_original: Is this the most colourful city in the world?

items.raw_excerpt: [Radio en vivo🎙] La UC vence a La Calera en la ida de octavos de la Copa Chile
items.summary_en: Universidad de O'Higgins beat Deportes Santa Cruz in the first leg of the Copa Chile round of 16. The second leg will decide which team reaches the quarter-finals. The game was played in Rancagua.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 코파 16강 1차전에서 오히긴스 대학교가 데포르테스 산타크루스를 이겼다. 2차전 결과에 따라 8강에 올라갈 팀이 정해진다. 경기는 랑카구아에서 열렸다.
items.title_en: O'Higgins beats Deportes Santa Cruz in Copa Chile first leg
items.title_original: O'Higgins vence a Deportes Santa Cruz en la ida de octavos de la Copa Chile

items.raw_excerpt: Seven years ago, Ah Nee Nwe had barely heard of the AFL. Today, the teenager is a grand final winner eyeing a place in history.
items.summary_en: Seven years ago, Ah Nee Nwe had barely heard of Australian rules football. Now the teenager from Nhill, Victoria, has won a junior premiership and hopes to be the first Karen player in the AFL.
items.summary_ko: 7년 전 아니뉴는 호주식 럭비를 거의 몰랐다. 이제 빅토리아주 닐 마을 출신 10대가 주니어 대회 우승을 거뒀고 카렌족 최초의 AFL 선수가 되겠다는 꿈을 품고 있다.
items.title_en: Junior premiership winner Ah Nee Nee wants to be the first Karen AFL player
items.title_ko: 카렌족 최초의 AFL 선수 꿈꾸는 주니어 우승자 아니뉴
items.title_original: Premiership winner Ah Nee Nwe wants to be first Karen AFL player

items.raw_excerpt: Maria Grazia Chiuri frees the body at Fendi, Meryll Rogge gives Marni’s quirks a generational spin and Simone Bellotti softens Jil Sander’s minimalism for Spring/Summer 2027.
items.summary_en: Fendi showed a lighter body shape at its Milan show. Marni mixed its look with a younger generation style. Jil Sander made its clean minimal style feel softer. The shows were part of Milan Fashion Week.
items.summary_ko: 밀란 쇼에서 핀디는 더 가벼운 실루엣을 보여줬다. 마르니는 자신만의 스타일에 젊은 세대의 분위기를 섞었다. 질 샌더는 간결한 미니멀 스타일을 더 부드럽게 만들었다. 이번 쇼들은 밀란 패션 위크의 일부였다.
items.title_en: Fashion Brands Soften Their Rules at Milan Fashion Week
items.title_ko: 밀란 패션 위크서 핀디, 마르니, 질 샌더가 하우스 룰을 풀다
items.title_original: At Milan Fashion Week, Fendi, Marni and Jil Sander loosen up their house codes

items.raw_excerpt: A road in Auckland's Remuera is blocked after a large tree fell on it.
items.summary_en: A large tree fell across a road in Remuera, Auckland. The tree blocked the road and the area was closed. No one was hurt.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드 레무에라에서 큰 나무가 도로 위로 쓰러졌다. 쓰러진 나무가 도로를 막아 해당 구간이 통제됐다. 다친 사람은 없다.
items.title_en: Fallen Tree Blocks Road in Remuera
